name: PolityMarket Daily Pipeline [DEPRECATED]

nodes.name: Daily 2AM IST
nodes.notes: Fires daily at 2:00 AM IST. Timezone set via GENERIC_TIMEZONE=Asia/Jerusalem in docker-compose.

nodes.name: Poll RSS Feeds
nodes.notes: Poll news RSS feeds for each politician. Configure RSS URLs in the Function node before this.

nodes.name: Fetch Telegram Data
nodes.notes: Fetch messages from monitored Telegram channels. Requires Telegram Bot Token credential.

nodes.name: Fetch X/Twitter Data
nodes.notes: Fetch tweets from monitored X lists. Requires X API Bearer Token credential.

nodes.name: Chunk & Clean Text
nodes.notes: Groups all fetched data by politician. Attaches thread context for sarcasm detection.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514', max_tokens: 500, temperature: 0.0, system: $node['Load System Prompt'].json.prompt, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: $json.userPrompt }] }) }}

nodes.name: LLM Scoring (Claude)
nodes.notes: Version-pinned Claude API call (claude-sonnet-4-20250514). Temperature locked at 0.0. Uses system prompt from prompts/system-prompt.txt. Retry 3x with exponential backoff.

nodes.name: Parse LLM Response
nodes.notes: Validates dimensional rubric ranges. Strips markdown fences from LLM output.

nodes.name: Compute Overall Score
nodes.notes: Deterministic weighted average — NOT computed by LLM.

nodes.name: Golden Dataset Check (Weekly)
nodes.notes: Runs golden dataset MSE evaluation every Sunday. Triggers drift alert if MSE > 0.15.

nodes.name: Format JSON Artifacts
nodes.notes: Creates two artifact types: timeseries_summary rows and daily detail file.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ message: 'chore: update daily scores [' + $json.date + ']', content: Buffer.from(JSON.stringify($json.data, null, 2)).toString('base64'), sha: $json.existing_sha || undefined }) }}

nodes.name: Push to GitHub
nodes.notes: Pushes JSON artifacts to GitHub repo via Contents API. This triggers the GitHub Actions deploy workflow.

nodes.name: Alert on Failure
nodes.notes: Sends alert to Slack/Telegram webhook on complete pipeline failure. Configure webhook URL in n8n credentials.

_comment_error_handling: Connect the 'Alert on Failure' node to the error output of 'LLM Scoring (Claude)' and 'Push to GitHub' nodes in the n8n UI after import. n8n's errorWorkflow setting requires a separate workflow ID, not a node ID.
